scope: Fortnite service maintenance, downtime, degradation and incidents relevant to France/Europe

source_of_truth.content_linkage: Fortnite News / Battle Pass / Competitive / other field-authorized official source
source_of_truth.rule: Service availability facts and Fortnite content facts are separate evidence domains and must be reconciled field by field.

principles.stable_identity: One logical Epic maintenance/incident keeps one immutable service_event_id across all updates, title changes and state transitions.
principles.event_sourcing: Never overwrite meaningful history; persist state transitions and material field changes as immutable history items.
principles.provider_vs_internal: provider_phase/provider_impact record what Epic explicitly publishes. Internal priority/actionability scores are derived triage only and must never be presented as official Epic severity.
principles.component_level_truth: Track service components independently; partial failure of one component never implies total Fortnite downtime.
principles.no_time_inference: Never invent expected recovery/end time or infer an extension merely because a service remains unavailable.
principles.relation_requires_evidence: Link to a season, patch, live event or competition only with official evidence for that relation.
principles.calendar_is_projection: The ledger is the source of truth. ICS files are user-facing projections for planned or materially useful service events.
principles.anti_noise: Routine component blips and short incidents stay ledger-only unless they become actionable or materially disruptive.
principles.europe_paris_display: Store source timestamps with original offset/UTC when known; render actionable user times explicitly in Europe/Paris.

dedupe_order: same kind + overlapping official time window + materially same affected component set
identity_policy.alias_ids: Store prior/external aliases; never create a second event merely because Epic changes the incident title or URL slug.
identity_policy.split_merge_guard: One Epic incident affecting many components remains one service event. Distinct Epic incident records remain separate unless Epic explicitly merges them.

timing_model.expected_end_rule: expected_end_at may be stored only when an authorized source explicitly publishes or updates it.
timing_model.extension_rule: EXTENDED requires explicit official extension/window change. Passage of time alone is never evidence.

component_snapshot_schema.rule: A global canonical state never erases per-component differences.

example_rules: LOGIN or MATCHMAKING MAJOR_OUTAGE materially increases actionability.
A WEBSITE_API-only degradation remains low unless it blocks a directly relevant action.
A scheduled season-launch downtime with exact start may be highly actionable even before impact begins.

relation_policy.season_launch: Epic Status confirms service facts; season_id/related_event_uid require an authorized Fortnite content source explicitly tying the downtime to that season.
relation_policy.patch: patch_version requires an official patch/update reference; timing coincidence is insufficient.
relation_policy.live_event: Link only when official communication associates downtime with the live event.
relation_policy.competitive: Link only when Fortnite Competitive/Epic Status explicitly establishes tournament-related maintenance or service impact.

calendar_policy.scheduled_maintenance: Promote when official start/date/time or actionable window is published.
calendar_policy.unplanned_incident: Ledger-only by default. Promote only when a published recovery/maintenance window exists, impact is MAJOR/TOTAL and prolonged enough that calendar visibility adds planning value, or the incident materially threatens a linked high-priority Fortnite event.
do_not_promote: resolved incident with no remaining planning value
status-page wording change with no business impact
calendar_policy.dtstart_policy: Use official scheduled start for planned maintenance; for promoted unplanned incidents use official actual start only if known precisely.
calendar_policy.dtend_policy: Use only official expected end/window. Never infer duration.
calendar_policy.resolved_policy: Keep same UID and audit history; remove future alarms. Do not delete merely because resolved.
calendar_policy.sequence_rule: Increment only when the projected VEVENT business data changes. Ledger-only verification, internal score changes or serialization-only maintenance do not increment SEQUENCE.

quiet_hours.urgent_exception: TOTAL/MAJOR unplanned outage, linked live event/competition at immediate risk, or scheduled downtime starting within 2 hours.

notification_policy.DOWNTIME_ANNOUNCED: Notify once when an actionable scheduled start/window is newly published, especially for season launch, major patch or live event.
notification_policy.STARTED: Notify for MAJOR/TOTAL, core LOGIN/MATCHMAKING impact, or a linked high-priority event; otherwise update silently.
notification_policy.EXTENDED: Notify once per materially new official extension/window update. Never infer from elapsed time.
notification_policy.RECOVERING: Usually silent; notify only after a prolonged major outage when recovery status is useful.
notification_policy.RESOLVED: Notify after major/total/prolonged outage or when a linked event becomes playable again. Routine scheduled maintenance resolution may remain silent.
notification_policy.CANCELLED: Notify when an actionable scheduled maintenance is cancelled or materially moved.
notification_policy.grouping: If multiple service events change within 10 minutes and clearly share one platform-wide cause, group into one user notification but preserve distinct ledger entries unless Epic merges them.

anti_false_positive.page_unreachable: Do not change service state merely because Epic Status cannot be fetched.
anti_false_positive.user_reports: User/social reports may prompt verification but never independently advance canonical state.
anti_false_positive.still_down: Continued outage without new official information does not equal EXTENDED.
anti_false_positive.partial_recovery: One recovered component does not mean global RESOLVED.
anti_false_positive.component_failure: One failed component does not imply TOTAL unless provider evidence supports total service impact.
anti_false_positive.title_change: Provider title edits do not create a new service event.

retention_policy.archive_rule: Resolved/cancelled records may later move to a service archive while preserving service_event_id, metrics, relations and full material history. Never recycle IDs.

metrics_policy.no_fake_precision: Do not compute durations from DATE_ONLY or unknown timestamps.

watch_targets.promotion_rule: Create a service entry only when Epic publishes an actual maintenance/incident record or actionable downtime window. Link it to the next season only with official content evidence.
